query: When read-only repository inspection suggests related cross-file calls, locate the command dispatcher and the helper that ranks actual import-bound edges.
The ASK retrieval pipeline expands nearby source chunks around first-pass hits. Locate the retrieval orchestrator and the neighboring-chunk expansion helper it calls.
Unified Agent hybrid search delegates to the ASK retrieval pipeline. Locate the Agent search provider and the retrieval function it invokes.
The capability scorecard computes repository retrieval metrics for loaded evaluation cases. Locate the scorecard command and the retrieval evaluator it calls.
